name: walkorbit_flannel_hat
prompt: Five one-second shots joined by hard cuts. The woman walks on the spot the whole time and never turns, always facing the same way; only the camera moves, round to her left, always high above looking down on her head, always at the same distance: shot 1 from the front, 2 front-left (mostly her front), 3 her left side, 4 back-left (mostly her back), 5 behind. Quick, short, even steps, three every second, never a run. Flat chroma-key blue background.
